topics.titleEn: Nodule fears around regenerative fillers (结节增生): what actually causes lumps and how to reduce the risk
topics.titleZh: 少女针结节增生是真的吗？再生填充的硬块风险怎么降低
topics.angle: Material change: 少女针 chips gained 结节增生 (nodule hyperplasia) — this is the SECOND safety-concern chip on regenerative fillers after 铓化修复 from 09-11. Combined signal: patients are increasingly afraid of lumps/hard nodules from PLLA/PCL/Ellansé-type products. Article: what nodules actually are (product clumping vs granuloma vs normal palpability), why they form (dilution, placement, massage, individual response), which product types carry higher risk, prevention at the clinic level (proper dilution protocol, follow-up schedule), and what to do if you feel a lump after treatment. Distinct from regen-filler-overfill-repair (volume excess) — this is the texture/lump angle.

topics.titleEn: CAHA/Radiesse removal (取出): when it's actually needed, what it involves, and how to decide
topics.titleZh: 微晶瓷取出：什么时候真的需要，怎么做
topics.angle: Material change: 微晶瓷 chips gained 取出 (removal) — now co-dominant with site-specific chips; removal doctor (周云超异物取出) in top3 for second consecutive run. This is NOT a new concern (异物取出 was present 09-11) but 取出 as a standalone chip means it's now a primary search intent, not a sub-topic. Article: decision tree for CAHA removal (observation vs intervention), what the procedure actually involves (incision vs injection-assisted), recovery expectations, and crucially: when NOT to remove (asymmetry that will settle, overreaction to normal palpability). Fills the removal gap in caha-site-selector-removal (backlog).
